title: Implement GCS v5 trait bonus calculation
body:
## Goal

Implement the next engine slice after PR #4: GCS v5 `trait_bonus` feature processing for bonus-aware trait levels and point calculation.

## Scope

- Add `calculateGcsTraitPointsWithBonusesV5(...)`.
- Keep `calculateGcsTraitPointsV5(...)` and its nil-entity behavior unchanged.
- Process typed `trait_bonus` features from enabled leaf traits and enabled leaf trait modifiers.
- Match target trait names and tags using pinned GCS v5.44.0 criteria and replacement behavior.
- Support fixed and per-level bonuses, including modifier `useLevelFromTrait`.
- Detect bonus dependency cycles and depth above 256 with stable error codes and JSON-pointer paths.
- Reuse the existing immutable calculation result tree and calculation core.
- Extend the pinned Go traits oracle with `traits.calculate_with_bonuses`.
- Keep production TypeScript-only with zero runtime dependencies.

## Out of scope

- Other feature types or a generic feature framework.
- Skills, spells, equipment, weapons, attributes, prerequisites, or full `Entity.Recalculate`.
- Calculation traces/tooltips, document mutation, `calc` write-back, or web UI work.

## Acceptance criteria

- The new public API and error types are exported from the built package.
- Existing nil-entity calculation behavior remains unchanged.
- Provider activation, criteria, replacements, fixed/per-level amounts, clamping, and `useLevelFromTrait` behavior match pinned GCS for the supported slice.
- Unsupported feature types remain opaque.
- Malformed recognized bonuses fail deterministically with precise paths.
- Results remain deeply frozen and preserve input order and structure.
- Synthetic vectors and all committed fixtures pass differential conformance in both modifier modes.
- Cycle/depth defenses have TypeScript unit coverage.
- The canonical Docker gate passes:

  ```sh
  docker compose run --rm toolchain pnpm check
  ```

## Implementation process

- Follow the repository and nested engine `AGENTS.md` instructions.
- Implement through TDD with recorded RED/GREEN evidence.
- Use the pinned GCS v5.44.0 source and test-only oracle as the behavioral authority.
- Complete specification-compliance, code-quality, and final branch reviews before merge.

## Product sequencing

After this engine slice, prepare the separate web stack proposal and implement a thin local `.gcs` import → bonus-aware trait tree viewer.
